emotional_tone: Authoritative, clear, function-first, and highly efficient.
design_principles: Prioritize scanning over reading: users glance first, so place the most important information in the top-left.
Design for decisions, not data volume: Show only metrics users need to act on (e.g., active promos, stockouts).
Color is Function Only: 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
Control Room Grid: Use dense, functional bento grids without wasting vertical space, ensuring every pixel is utilized.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy inside elements, with sharp Control Room grids for layout.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense content and metrics. Optical alignment for icons.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-zinc-200), no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Solid White background with a hard bottom border (border-zinc-200).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: Sharp corners or max 8px radius. High contrast.

components_strategy.general: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to be flat, with 1px borders and neutral backgrounds.
components_strategy.tables: Dense, crisp lines. No alternating row colors, just clean bottom borders.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Monochrome with single accent color (#002FA7) to highlight key data points.
components_strategy.ai_explanations: Use 'Grid Borders' micro-theme: Expose the skeleton, use border-collapse style layouts for AI reasoning steps.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Inputs, strict left alignment, clear required states.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Always explicitly set text color on hover. Use transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
motion_and_interaction.focus_states: High contrast focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-2.
motion_and_interaction.ai_loading: Use minimal monospaced loaders or subtle pulse animations instead of generic spinners for AI recommendations.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the typography pairings: Outfit for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings under any circumstances.
For the UI, avoid dark-mode tech looks. Use the bright, stark white and zinc-100 backgrounds with sharp 1px borders.
The primary CTA color is International Klein Blue (#002FA7). Use it sparingly for primary actions only. Limit other colors.
All cards and containers must use p-6 or p-8 padding and max 8px border-radius.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the Analytics Dashboard: dense, aligned to the top, utilizing all horizontal space.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
Use Shadcn UI for all complex interactive elements, customizing their Tailwind classes to match the 1px flat border aesthetic.
